verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent Studio/SDK let teams define step-by-step journeys/workflows, and Insights mentions experimenting with 'hand-off rules' and split-traffic release rules, implying some rule-based triggering of agent actions. However, there is no explicit documentation of a general-purpose event-trigger/rules engine (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' conditional automation) as a first-class feature. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger rule definition UI/API, examples of arbitrary condition-action rules, and independent verification of this automation capability.
